answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in bridge, expire in jetty, and horizon lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 121 aliases as a result needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
